title: Query Logs Are Patient Records: An Unguarded Attack Surface in Clinical RAG, and a Privacy-Preserving Pipeline
description: In privacy-sensitive applications, the server observes the query and controls which evidence is returned, creating both confidentiality and integrity risks. Our protocol reduces private and verifiable retrieval to multiplication of a committed matrix by an encrypted vector and uses low-bit quantization to make this computation practical.

paper.title: Query Logs Are Patient Records: An Unguarded Attack Surface in Clinical RAG, and a Privacy-Preserving Pipeline
paper.authors: Louis Tremblay Thibault, Sofiane Azogagh, Marc-Olivier Killijian, Ulrich Aïvodji

example_outputs.title: Default inputs
example_outputs.summary: An insider rebuilt 20 of 21 synthetic patient records from the query log. Under encryption, retrieval stayed exact and 4-bit embeddings kept 97% of float nDCG@10. The clinic, patients and queries are synthetic. The paper's succinct proofs are not reproduced, and timings come from one sandbox CPU.

inputs.label: Your clinical query
inputs.default: Metastatic renal cell carcinoma, second-line therapy after progression
inputs.description: The question a clinician might type into a literature assistant. Added to the synthetic log and run through the encrypted pipeline

inputs.label: Logged at
inputs.description: Time of day (HH:MM) the query is logged; the insider joins it to the appointment in progress

inputs.label: Corpus
inputs.description: scifact (5,183 abstracts) or nfcorpus (3,633 docs), the paper's two BEIR corpora

inputs.label: Corpus size
inputs.description: Cap on documents (0 = all). Capping keeps every judged-relevant doc, so nDCG rises

inputs.label: Bit-widths
inputs.description: Quantization bit-widths for the nDCG@10 sweep (each 2–12)

inputs.label: Encrypted bit-width
inputs.description: b used in the encrypted run (paper's operating point: 4)

inputs.label: Embedder
inputs.description: model2vec static embedder (30 MB). minishlab/potion-retrieval-32M is stronger but a 129 MB download

inputs.label: Appointments
inputs.description: Booked 20-minute slots in the synthetic clinic day (4–24)

inputs.label: Lookup lag
inputs.description: Max minutes between visit start and the clinician's query; beyond the slot length the join starts to mislink

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.description: Random seed for the synthetic clinic and query sample
